sn45.23:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the wrong way and the right way.
sn45.23:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is the wrong way?
sn45.23:1.5: It is: wrong view … wrong concentration.
sn45.23:1.6: This is called the wrong way.
sn45.23:1.7: “And what, bhikkhus, is the right way?
sn45.23:1.8: It is: right view … right concentration.
sn45.23:1.9: This is called the right way.”
